core_obligations: Reduce and identify: since the centre of the symplectic group has order two, the author's remark shows there is only one Tits algebra to consider, and it is the quaternion division algebra over Q (proof lines 662-663).

Apply the division-algebra description: the single class is a division algebra after base change to R exactly when the quaternion algebra does not split over R, which by the author's division-algebra description of universality is precisely the stated criterion (proof lines 663-664).
proof_roadmap: 由辛群中心为 2 阶，只需一个 Tits 代数，它就是四元数除法代数本身。
再由除法代数判据：该 Tits 代数在张量 R 后仍是除法代数当且仅当四元数代数在 R 上不分裂，即所证。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the R-universality criterion for the special unitary Lie algebra attached to a Hermitian form over a quaternion division algebra with the reversion involution (author prop at source lines 651-659): universality holds exactly when the quaternion algebra does not split over R. The proof (source lines 661-665) is two sentences long and its content is the reduction to a single Tits algebra — the centre of the symplectic group having order two — and the identification of that algebra with the quaternion division algebra, after which the author's division-algebra description of universality gives the equivalence immediately. The card keeps the author's own level of detail. H2.
